title: The Plantation Club in Watts with Billie Holiday, Eckstine and Sarah Vaughan
summary: The band plays a large club on the outskirts of Los Angeles on a bill with Billie Holiday, though nobody yet knows Sarah; she earned about $150 a week.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Anyway, we went on, and after that little incident, we were to play this club in Los Angeles called the Plantation Club. It was in a little place outside of Los Angeles, or on the outskirts or the suburbs or something of Los Angeles, that later became very popular -- or became rather famous, I should say, famous or infamous or whatever. A place called Watts. They had this great big club out there called the Plantation Club. It was a very beautiful place. They featured big bands and big shows out there. We got out there...

At that particular time, no one realized what was really happening. But here we are with the Billy Eckstine band, Sarah Vaughan vocalist, and starring in the show was Billie Holiday. So you had these three vocalists... Of course, Billie Holiday was a big name then, Billy Eckstine had a fairly big name, but no one knew anything about Sarah. But these are the kinds of situations that you'd have to have quite a lot of foresight to really realize what's going on. I often think about it now. I think about the guys in the band as well.... .Situations like that happening, with Sarah,

Billie Holiday and Billy Eckstine on the same bill. If all of those people could be gotten together now to make up a band or a show or something, a fortune would have to be spent. Whereas Sarah was making about $150 a week then.
